title.en: Stay on one row while resolving is LZ-60 the 50 m³/h off-grid pump
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：LZ-60 是那台 50 m³/h 的无电网泵吗

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints LZ-60 for sites without stable grid power at 50 m³/h, 6105 / 145 kW, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below and 5500 kg. Keep this cell as published. The other 50 m³/h page is electric HBT80-16, which needs 110 kW and prints a different distance. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Off-grid work stays on LZ-60.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：是。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-60 印给电网不便的工地：50 m³/h、6105 / 145 kW、35 MPa、输送 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、5500 kg。另一张 50 m³/h 的页面是电动 HBT80-16，它需要 110 kW，距离也不同。无电网作业留在 LZ-60。

h1.en: Stay on one row while resolving is LZ-60 the 50 m³/h off-grid pump
h1.zh: 选型时不要并格：LZ-60 是那台 50 m³/h 的无电网泵吗

directAnswer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints LZ-60 for sites without stable grid power at 50 m³/h, 6105 / 145 kW, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below and 5500 kg. Keep this cell as published. The other 50 m³/h page is electric HBT80-16, which needs 110 kW and prints a different distance. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Off-grid work stays on LZ-60.
directAnswer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：是。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-60 印给电网不便的工地：50 m³/h、6105 / 145 kW、35 MPa、输送 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、5500 kg。另一张 50 m³/h 的页面是电动 HBT80-16，它需要 110 kW，距离也不同。无电网作业留在 LZ-60。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Compression Ratio” in “Compressed Air vs. Free Air - Compression Ratio”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes for that diesel page: 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints LZ-60 for sites without stable grid power at 50 m³/h, 6105 / 145 kW, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below and 5500 kg. Keep this cell as published. That aggregate cell is a reason to open LZ-60 rather than Diesel 60, which shares a code string but does not print this aggregate cell and prints 35 m³/h. Taken from the printed row: The height cell is 300 m, not Diesel 120’s 500 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 100 / 125 mm. Keep this cell as published. No. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/free-compressed-air-d_1190.html
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Compressed Air vs. Free Air - Compression Ratio》的“比值”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：是这一页柴油泵：145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送 100 m、高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。HBT80-16 才是电动的 50 m³/h 页。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不要用柴油60的 150 m / 350 m 替换它。高度格是 300 m，不是柴油120的 500 m。更长的无电网垂直列出是另一个型号。这一格照已印出的读：100 / 125 mm。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/free-compressed-air-d_1190.html

body.en: “Compressed Air vs. Free Air - Compression Ratio” breaks its subject at “Compression Ratio - Pressure (psi)”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: HBT80-16 is the electric 50 m³/h page. Read it in the Xingtai table. The other 50 m³/h page is electric HBT80-16, which needs 110 kW and prints a different distance. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Stone above 4 cm leaves LZ-60 for LZ-80 or Diesel 120, both at 6 cm and below, if their distance cells also fit. Keep this cell as published. A longer off-grid vertical listing is a different model. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h.
body.zh: 《Compressed Air vs. Free Air - Compression Ratio》在“比值压力压力单位”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。是。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 LZ-60 印给电网不便的工地：50 m³/h、6105 / 145 kW、35 MPa、输送 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、5500 kg。另一张 50 m³/h 的页面是电动 HBT80-16，它需要 110 kW，距离也不同。无电网作业留在 LZ-60。按邢台表上的原文理解：如果这就是你要核对的匹配，请写明 4 cm 及以下、输送 100 m、无电网。旁边那一台不在这句话里。是。印的是 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，总重 5500 kg。

body.en: Borrow “Compression Ratio - Pressure (bar)” from “Compressed Air vs. Free Air - Compression Ratio” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Yes. Taken from the printed row: Off-grid work stays on LZ-60. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not replace it with Diesel 60’s 150 m / 350 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. State 4 cm or below, 100 m conveying and no grid, if that is the match you want checked. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Taken from the printed row: 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m, as printed, and total weight 5500 kg. Headings already printed: 4 cm is printed here 100 m conveying is the horizontal-style limit on this page
body.zh: 把《Compressed Air vs. Free Air - Compression Ratio》的“比值压力巴”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：这个骨料格是打开 LZ-60 而不是柴油60的理由。柴油60共用一串代号，但没有这个骨料格，输送量是 35 m³/h。石子超过 4 cm，就离开 LZ-60，去看 LZ-80 或柴油120，两台都是 6 cm 及以下，前提是它们的距离格也对。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。按邢台表上的原文理解：不包含。4100 印的是 6–12 m³/h。已印出的标题：这里印了 4 cm 这一页的输送距离上限是 100 m

question.en: “Compression Ratio” does not change the check: What pipe diameter is printed?
question.zh: “比值”不改这一问：印了什么管径？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. 100 / 125 mm.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：100 / 125 mm。

question.en: Is the size in metres, once the outline says “Compression Ratio - Pressure (psi)”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“比值压力压力单位”时，外形是用米标的吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: Yes. 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m, as printed, and total weight 5500 kg.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：是。印的是 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，总重 5500 kg。

question.en: Under “Compression Ratio - Pressure (bar)”, does off-grid include the tractor 4100 at 50 m³/h?
question.zh: 在“比值压力巴”这一节里，无电网包含 50 m³/h 的拖拉机4100吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. The 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不包含。4100 印的是 6–12 m³/h。
